items.stem: What is the correct order of the DMAIC phases?
items.explanation: Correct: DMAIC is Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve, Control.

items.stem: Which TWO belong in the Measure phase? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: you must trust the data before using it.
Correct: a baseline is set in Measure.

items.stem: A team rolls out a fix across all shifts without a pilot and the gain does not hold. Which DMAIC lesson was missed?

options.text: Improvements should be piloted and verified before full rollout
options.rationale: Correct: Improve requires piloting and verifying before scaling.

options.text: The problem statement was too SMART
options.rationale: A SMART statement is desirable, not a cause here.

options.text: Too much data was collected in Measure
options.rationale: That is not the cause of the failed rollout.
Control charts do not cause instability.
